productIds.title: Product IDs
productIds.description: Positive decimal product IDs as strings. Supply IDs, full URLs, or both. Duplicate products are returned once per run.

startUrls.title: Full Shopee Vietnam product URLs
startUrls.description: Full HTTPS shopee.vn URLs in /product/shop_id/item_id or /name-i.shop_id.item_id format. Short links and URL-list files are not supported.

maxItems.title: Maximum unique products
maxItems.description: Process up to this many unique products, with a maximum of 1,000 unique inputs. Results may be up to 15 minutes old.
